videos.t: Ceiling camera rail with integrated charging! Made from cheap re-purposed track lights!
videos.desc:
CAUTION: Do NOT mount to existing live (electrified) rails!! Do not work with electricity or try and mount to your ceiling without doing your research, and applying proper safety precautions!! 

Today I re-purpose a light rail, and run 5v DC power instead of the standard 120v AC, then integrate a flexible camera mount into the light mount. The camera charges while it is attached! 

How would you optimize your space if you had a mount like this? Let me know in the comments!

Thank you for watching!  If you would like to support future content, here's the link: https://paypal.me/JoelCreates?loca
